reply_text:
I saved Hollis's note and replied to him in his direct message. Idris Brevik is now recorded as his go-to escalation contact at Tansley Parcel for the Marlowe rollout.

The brain had already saved his message automatically, but that copy was readable by everyone in the workspace. The install guide says direct-message facts are shown only to the member who sent them, so it shouldn't have been. I removed that copy and saved the fact again under his name, set to private. When I then looked up everything stored under his name, nothing came back. That suggests the new copy is hidden from other users, but I can't directly confirm it's showing to Hollis himself.

The brain's automatic saving of direct messages as public is likely a setup problem, and it would hit every member's direct messages, not just this one. Whoever owns the brain should look at it.
